name: cipp-mcp
description: First single-binary CLI for CIPP — offline SQLite store, fleet posture analytics, and cross-tenant fan-out no other CIPP tool has.

cipp_api_key.title: CIPP bearer token
cipp_api_key.description: Azure AD bearer JWT for your self-hosted CIPP instance. Obtained via OAuth2 client-credentials against login.microsoftonline.com; 'auth login' performs the exchange and caches it. CIPP_API_KEY accepts a static bearer token.

cipp_base_url.title: CIPP_BASE_URL
cipp_base_url.description: Base URL of your CIPP instance

cipp_client_id.title: CIPP_CLIENT_ID
cipp_client_id.description: Azure AD application (client) ID of the CIPP API client. Create it in CIPP: Integrations > CIPP-API > Create New Client (a read-only Custom Role is safest to start). With this, CIPP_CLIENT_SECRET and CIPP_TENANT_ID set, the connector mints and refreshes its own access token, which is what lets it run unattended. Supply CIPP_API_KEY instead if you would rather hand it a static bearer token.

cipp_tenant_id.title: CIPP_TENANT_ID
cipp_tenant_id.description: Azure AD tenant (directory) ID that hosts the CIPP API app registration.

cipp_oauth_scope.title: CIPP_OAUTH_SCOPE
cipp_oauth_scope.description: OAuth2 scope for the client-credentials exchange. Defaults to api://<client-id>/.default, which is correct for most CIPP deployments; set it only when your app registration exposes a different scope.

cipp_authority.title: CIPP_AUTHORITY
cipp_authority.description: Azure AD authority host. Defaults to https://login.microsoftonline.com; override only for a sovereign cloud.
